part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `src/diff/props.js:121`: the casing-inference logic lowercases event names only when `name.toLowerCase() in dom` (e.g. `onClick` → `on` + `click` exists as a DOM property). `onfocusin`/`onfocusout` aren't DOM properties, so `onFocusIn` kept its casing and registered a listener for the non-standard `FocusIn` event instead of `focusin`.

The fix (matching upstream preact 10.20.x) explicitly maps `onFocusIn`/`onFocusOut` to lowercase: `focusin`/`focusout`.

Validation: full karma browser suite passes (1145 tests, including the new `should support camel-case focus event names` case), plus `test:mocha` (29 passing).
